The invention discloses a gene mutation engineering device for biological gene medicine. The novel variable-speed electric motor comprises a base, a circular groove is formed in the top of the base, a disc is installed in the circular groove in a rotating mode, the center of the bottom of the disc is fixedly connected with the tail end of an output shaft of a motor, the end of the output shaft of the motor is fixedly connected with the inner wall of the bottom of the circular groove, a sliding rheostat device used for controlling the rotating speed of the motor is arranged in the base, a space dynamic transformation mechanism is arranged on the disc, the space position state of a seed needing to be varied is continuously changed by the space dynamic transformation mechanism, the probability of gene mutation is increased, the rotating speed of the space dynamic transformation mechanism can be controlled by the sliding rheostat device, the type and degree of the gene mutation can be controlled, the space dynamic transformation mechanism comprises an elastic clamping support mechanism which is bilaterally symmetrical to the top of.

Gene mutation engineering device for biological gene medicineTechnical Field

The invention relates to the technical field of gene engineering, in particular to a gene mutation engineering device for biological gene medicines.

Background

Genetic engineering (also known as gene splicing technology and DNA recombination technology) is based on molecular genetics as a theoretical basis and takes modern methods of molecular biology and microbiology as a means. The genes from different sources are constructed into hybrid DNA molecules in vitro according to a pre-designed blueprint, and then the hybrid DNA molecules are introduced into living cells to change the original genetic characteristics of organisms, obtain new varieties and produce new products.

Sudden, heritable variations (gene mutation) of genomic DNA molecules occur. From a molecular level, a gene mutation is a change in the base pair composition or arrangement order of a gene in its structure. Genes are relatively stable, although they are able to replicate themselves precisely at cell division. Under certain conditions, the gene can be suddenly changed from the original existing form to another new existing form, namely, a new gene is suddenly appeared at a position to replace the original gene, and the gene is called a mutant gene. The progeny then suddenly exhibit a new trait never owned by the ancestor.

1 gene can be inherited within the structure change. Also known as point mutations, often cause some phenotypic change. Generalized mutations include chromosomal aberrations. Mutation in the narrow sense is specifically referred to as mutation. In practice the limits of distortion and point mutations are not clear, especially for subtle distortions. The wild-type gene is mutated into a mutant-type gene. The term mutant refers to both a mutant gene and an individual having such a mutant gene.

The gene mutation can occur at any stage of development, usually at the DNA replication stage, namely the cell interphase including the mitotic phase and the meiotic phase, and simultaneously the gene mutation is related to the replication of deoxyribonucleic acid, DNA damage repair, canceration and senescence, and the gene mutation is also one of important factors of biological evolution, so that the research on the gene mutation has wide biological significance in addition to the theoretical significance per se. The gene mutation provides mutant for genetic research and provides material for breeding work, so that the gene mutation has practical significance in scientific research and production.

However, the development of the current novel medicine needs to have a new medicinal material, the new medicinal material needs specific gene mutation of seeds, and the gene mutation can not occur on the earth with more comfortable environment, so that under the condition of more developed aerospace technology, people start to put the needed seeds into a space capsule for mutation and then return to the earth for cultivation and planting, the method has higher cost and can be performed for a long time, the requirement can not be met for the development field of continuously updated medicines, a device with lower cost and stable mutation does not exist in the existing medicine development laboratory, the protection for experimenters is limited, and the gene mutation engineering device for the biological gene medicine is urgently needed.

Disclosure of Invention

The invention aims to provide a gene mutation engineering device for biological gene medicines, which fundamentally solves the problems of long mutation time, high cost, high risk, limited operation and the like of the conventional medicine seeds and has the advantages of simple structure, low cost, high mutation rate, short research period, convenient operation and the like.

In order to achieve the purpose, the invention provides the following technical scheme: a gene mutation engineering device for biological gene medicine comprises a base, wherein a circular groove is formed in the top of the base, a disc is rotatably installed in the circular groove, the center of the bottom of the disc is fixedly connected with the tail end of an output shaft of a motor embedded in the inner wall of the bottom of the circular groove, a sliding rheostat device for controlling the rotating speed of the motor is arranged in the base, a space dynamic transformation mechanism is arranged on the disc and used for constantly transforming the space position state of a needed mutation seed to increase the gene mutation probability, the sliding rheostat device can control the rotating speed of the space dynamic transformation mechanism so as to control the type, degree and the like of gene mutation, the space dynamic transformation mechanism comprises an elastic clamping and supporting mechanism which is arranged on the top of the base in a bilateral symmetry manner and two rotating hemispherical shells which are rotatably connected with the elastic clamping and supporting mechanism and can be matched with the elastic clamping and supporting mechanism, it also comprises a transmission component which is arranged in the base and is used for controlling the two hemispherical shells which are combined into a sphere and then rotate, the device also comprises a seed storage ball which is used for being placed in the sphere formed by the two hemispherical shells arranged behind the close wall, the seed storage ball is used for further increasing the gene mutation probability by violent rolling in the ball formed by the two hemispherical shells after being matched, the device also comprises a double-layer cover for covering the circular groove, the disc and the space dynamic transformation mechanism, wherein the double-layer cover comprises a first-level protective cover which is fixedly clamped with the base, a second-level protective cover which is fixedly clamped with the disc and rotates along with the disc is rotatably connected in the protective cover through a fixed plate and a fixed rotating shaft, the double-layer cover is used for forming a gene mutation space and can also protect the radiation leakage from causing harm to experimenters.

As a preferable technical solution, the sliding rheostat device comprises an insulating chute which is arranged inside the base and is positioned at the bottom of the circular groove and has a rightward opening, a coil resistor is fixedly connected to the inner wall of the left end of the insulating chute, a lead wire is electrically connected to the left end of the coil resistor, the lead wire at the end is electrically connected to a motor, a butting electric connection copper sheet is embedded on the inner wall of the bottom of the insulating chute, the bottom of the butting electric connection copper sheet is electrically connected to another section of the lead wire which is electrically connected to a storage battery, an insulating control key is slidably connected in the insulating chute, the left end of the insulating control key is fixedly connected to a connecting ring which is in butting electric connection with the coil resistor through a connecting rod, the bottom of the connecting ring is electrically connected to a copper head which is in butting electric connection with the butting electric connection copper sheet, and the resistance is changed by pushing and pulling, therefore, the resistance value in the lead is changed to finally change the voltage and current values so as to change the rotating speed of the motor, thereby controlling the rotating speed of the space dynamic transformation mechanism and further changing the gene mutation effect.

As a preferable technical scheme, the elastic clamping and supporting mechanism comprises sliding grooves cut on the top of the disc in bilateral symmetry, supporting plates are connected in the sliding grooves in a sliding manner, the tops of the supporting plates extend out of the sliding grooves and are rotatably provided with first rotating shafts on the tops of the corresponding end surfaces, the tail ends of the other ends of the first rotating shafts are fixedly connected with the hemispherical shell, the tops of the end surfaces, which are far away from each other, of the supporting plates are fixedly connected with protruding parts which are used for being in sliding connection with the two-stage protective cover to push the two supporting plates to be close to each other, fixed sliding rods which penetrate through the supporting plates and are in sliding connection with the supporting plates are fixedly connected in the sliding grooves, reverse pushing springs which surround the fixed sliding rods are fixedly connected on the end surfaces, which are close to each other, of the supporting plates and the inner walls of the, the automatic positioning is closed when the parcel begins to work, and the convenient opening of automation when taking out the seed reduces unnecessary power component design, increases manufacturing cost.

As the preferred technical scheme, can form complete spherical shell when the hemisphere shell is including controlling two lamellas and putting the wall together, be equipped with a plurality of bolts that circumference distributes on the hemisphere shell section of left end, be equipped with on the hemisphere shell section of right-hand member be used for with the jack that the bolt was pegged graft can form the follow-up high rotational speed of being convenient for through perfect grafting of bolt and jack and do not have the spheroid rotation work of separation, increase job stabilization nature, be equipped with sealed the pad on the hemisphere shell section of left end, form safer sudden change environment, two hemisphere shells all fixedly connected with can form the half gear of a fixed gear on cutting the section edge, the fixed gear be used for with transmission assembly connects and is convenient for the location butt joint to drive the rotation of spherical shell. And a bouncing component for bouncing the seed storage ball is arranged in the inner wall of the hemispherical shell, and the bouncing component is used for bouncing the seed storage ball in the rotating spherical shell to increase the gene mutation probability.

As a preferable technical scheme, the bouncing assembly is provided with a plurality of bouncing assemblies along the inner wall of the hemispherical shell, the bouncing assemblies comprise elastic copper sheets fixedly connected on the inner wall of the hemispherical shell, a buffer groove is arranged in a wall body corresponding to the elastic copper sheets, a stress block is slidably connected in the buffer groove, the stress block is fixedly connected with a push rod which is close to the center of the hemispherical shell and extends into the inner cavity of the hemispherical shell and is abutted against the elastic copper sheets, a force generating rod which is far away from the center of the hemispherical shell is slidably connected in the buffer groove, one end of the force generating rod extends out of the hemispherical shell, the other end of the force generating rod is fixedly connected with a firing pin for striking the stress block, a restoring spring is fixedly connected between the force generating rod and the stress block, and the bouncing assembly further comprises a plurality of cross rods which are different in length and are fixedly connected on the mutually close, the other end of the cross rod is fixedly connected with a pushing ball which is used for being in sliding connection with the tail end of the force applying rod to push the force applying rod, so that the elastic copper sheet is continuously impacted by the self-rotating force of the ball shell, the seeds are stored in the ball to violently bounce, and the gene mutation probability is increased.

As a preferable technical scheme, the transmission assembly comprises a first transmission cavity drilled in the inner wall of the bottom of the circular groove, the center of the top of the circular disc is opened upwards, and an internal gear circular groove drilled in the inner wall of the bottom of the circular groove, a second transmission cavity is arranged at the left end of the first transmission cavity, a first rotating shaft is rotatably installed between the first transmission cavity and the second transmission cavity, the right end of the first rotating shaft is fixedly connected with a first gear wheel positioned in the first transmission cavity, the first gear wheel is used for being meshed with the fixed gear, the other end of the first rotating shaft is fixedly connected with a first bevel gear positioned in the second transmission cavity, a second rotating shaft positioned at the top of the internal gear circular groove is rotatably installed in the inner wall of the bottom of the second transmission cavity, and the top of the second rotating shaft is fixedly connected with a second bevel gear used for being meshed with the first bevel gear, the bottom of the second rotating shaft extends into the inner tooth circular groove and is fixedly connected with a second gear rotating wheel in meshed connection with the inner tooth circular groove, so that the spherical shell can be driven to horizontally rotate and vertically rotate through the same power source through the rotating assembly, required spatial position conversion is completed, and gene mutation probability is increased.

As a preferred technical scheme, the seed storage ball comprises a separable half shell, a plug board which is circumferentially distributed is arranged on a section of the left half shell, a slot which is used for being plugged with the plug board is arranged on a section of the right half shell, and a stud of the plug board is connected with the end face of the hemispherical shell in a threaded manner and used for locking, so that the stability of seeds can be ensured, the spilling is prevented, the gene mutation effect is interfered, and the operation of the device is influenced even in severe cases.

As preferred technical scheme, be equipped with a plurality of first bayonets that circumference distributes on the one-level protection casing bottom terminal surface, be equipped with first joint ring groove on the base top end face, fixedly connected with be used for on the inner wall of first joint ring groove bottom with the first dop of first bayonet socket joint, it can be with the stable rotation prevention of one-level protection casing, has firm effect. In addition, be equipped with the display panel who is used for showing seed gene mutation effect on the base left end terminal surface, can control concrete change data in real time and prevent extravagant experimental study time.

The working principle is as follows:

1. initial state specification: the support plate 109 is located in the slide 123 furthest from the center, in which case the two hemispherical shells 110 are separated from each other, the fixed gearwheel is separated into the half gearwheel 122 and from the first gearwheel 118, the double-layer cover is placed aside separately from the device, the connecting ring 143 is located at the rightmost end of the coil resistance 148, in which case the resistance is the greatest, and the two half shells 162 are separated from each other.

2. When seeds need to be loaded, the seeds with the needed gene mutation are placed into the half shell 162, then the two half shells are combined, the inserting plate 159 is inserted into the inserting groove 157, then the two half shells are locked by the stud 158, and then the whole half shell 110 is placed.

3. The machine set is closed, the double-layer cover is taken up through the pull head 141, the double-layer cover is aligned to the first clamping ring groove 107 and pressed downwards, the half shell 162 is matched with the wall due to the pressure of the protruding part 112 and the secondary protective cover 135 until the plug pin 121 is inserted into the insertion hole 161, at the moment, the first clamping opening 133 is clamped with the first clamping head 106, the second clamping opening 134 is clamped with the second clamping head 134, and meanwhile, the half gear 122 is matched with the wall and is in meshed connection with the first gear wheel 118.

4. The mutation atmosphere creation work is started, the space is vacuumed by the vacuum pump 137, and various radiation factors are emitted by the mutation factor emitting device 139.

5. When the rotation speed needs to be changed, only the insulation button 145 needs to be pressed, the resistance value changes, the rotation of the motor 129 is changed, the effect of the mechanical change factor can be changed, and when mutation occurs, various seed gene data can be seen on the display panel 101 until the most needed genes are reached.

6. When the seeds need to be taken out, the seeds can be taken out only by removing the lower double-layer cover and taking out the seed storage ball 132, then the seeds are taken out and planted, and the corresponding medicinal material part is collected to develop the medicine.
